column1: # Retired apocalyptic overlays removed; original catalogue supplies these NPC lines.

column3:
The prisoners kept begging
to be let out before
Colosso began.{page_break}Even thieves wanted to
see the tournament. I
can't say I blame them.{end_wait}
The thieves you caught\nbroke out of jail.\nNo one saw how.{end_wait}
We feared they'd hunt\nyou down. Have you seen\nthem?{end_now}
Those men wanted you\ndead. Keep your eyes open.{end_wait}

You catch the thieves,
and we let them walk
right out the door.{page_break}We're a joke, and we
know it.{end_wait}
If we stay alert, they\nwon't surprise us.\n...I keep telling myself.{end_wait}
It's humiliating that the\nthieves slipped away.\nWe can't even guard a cell.{end_wait}
I made soup, so now I\nhave all these bones.{page_break}...You want some?{end_now}
You do? Really?\nTake as many as you like.\nThere's plenty left.{end_wait}
Right. Nobody can live\non bones alone, can they?{end_wait}
I hit a man in a rage\nand they locked me up.\nIt was stupid of me.{end_wait}
I need to master my\ntemper. It's the only\nthing I can still control.{end_wait}

The Silk Road's closed.
Nothing gets through.{page_break}If you're going to Tolbi,
you'll have to cross
the Karagol Sea.{end_wait}
Silk Road is closed. The\nship's our only way across,\nand the fare is steep.{end_wait}
People walk up Silk Road\nand come back again.\nNo one's made it through.{end_wait}
With Silk Road blocked, the\ncaptain can name his price.\nI don't like it.{end_wait}
My daughter left Tolbi\nto meet us at the docks.\nI hope she isn't waiting.{end_wait}
A year planning this trip.\nOne rockslide and\neverything fell apart.{end_wait}
I hate charging this much\nfor a ticket. The captain\nsays we have no choice.{end_wait}
A full ship puts the\ncaptain in a good mood.\nMakes my shift easier too.{end_wait}
Silk Road's blocked, so\neveryone seems to be taking\nthis ship.{end_wait}
There are so many\npassengers. Can the crew\neven get all of us across{page_break}the Karagol?{end_wait}
